title: Efficient and Robust Drafting with Multi-Token Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.25813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation into a drafting phase and a parallel verification phase. A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model. We present a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) architecture that extends existing backbone LLMs to efficiently produce high-quality drafts. Built around a single shared drafting head, our approach features three core architectural optimizations: target activation injection to anchor semantic planning, zero-copy KV-cache cross-attention to bypass prefill compute and reduce memory overhead, and an efficient clustered vocabulary projection to reduce the cost of full-vocabulary decoding. Testing these improvements with the Gemma 4 model family, our G-MTP shows out-of-the-box speedups for both

translated_title: 基于多词预测的高效且稳健的草稿生成
translated_abstract: 推测解码已成为加速大语言模型（LLM）推理的关键技术，其通过将生成过程解耦为草稿生成阶段和并行验证阶段来实现加速。因此，一个关键挑战是设计一个既轻量又足够准确的草稿生成器，以逼近目标模型的预测。我们提出了一种高度优化的多词预测架构，它扩展现有的主干大语言模型，以高效生成高质量草稿。我们的方法围绕单一共享草稿头构建，具有三项核心架构优化：目标激活注入以锚定语义规划、零拷贝KV缓存交叉注意力以绕过预填充计算并减少内存开销，以及高效的聚类词表投影以降低全词表解码的成本。在Gemma 4模型家族上测试这些改进，我们的G-MTP展现出了开箱即用的加速效果……
tldr: 提出了G-MTP——一种围绕单一共享草稿头构建的高度优化多词预测架构，通过目标激活注入、零拷贝KV缓存交叉注意力和聚类词表投影三项核心优化，使现有主干大语言模型能够高效生成高质量草稿，从而加速推测解码推理。
en_tdlr: We present G-MTP, a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction architecture built around a single shared drafting head, featuring target activation injection, zero-copy KV-cache cross-attention, and clustered vocabulary projection, enabling existing backbone LLMs to efficiently produce high-quality drafts for accelerated speculative decoding.
